effect.pohsmp_core.ascension.description: Hovering in light, no fall damage.
effect.pohsmp_core.divine_backlash.descr: The price of a divine spell: no mana recovery, weakness and slowness for the first seconds.
effect.pohsmp_core.dread.description: Slowness and weakness after a nightmare.
effect.pohsmp_core.forbidding_seal.descr: Cannot cast spells or drink potions.
effect.pohsmp_core.gravity_crush.descrip: Cannot jump or fly with elytra.
effect.pohsmp_core.nightmare_sleep.descr: Cannot move or attack. A hit wakes and deals 50% more damage.
fx.pohsmp_core.divine_taboo.title: DIVINE TABOO
fx.pohsmp_core.milky_way.title: MILKY WAY
fx.pohsmp_core.space_closure.title: CLOSING OF SPACE
spell.pohsmp_core.ashless_flame.guide: A blue circle flares under the target, a pillar of blue fire strikes, and three rings of flame run outward.
spell.pohsmp_core.eternal_blizzard.guide: A wall of everlasting snowstorm rises around the caster. Inside, the cold binds every step, harder the closer to the wall; the frost bites to the bone, and the storm itself drags back into the circle.
spell.pohsmp_core.fate_star.guide: A constellation lights up above the target, then a star falls. A random tarot card decides how.
spell.pohsmp_core.forbidding_seal.guide: A circle of six runes under the target. While it holds, no spells and no potions. Leaving the circle breaks a rune.
spell.pohsmp_core.nightmare_cradle.guide: The target falls asleep into a nightmare. A hit wakes it and lands harder; left alone, it wakes in dread.
spell.pohsmp_core.singularity.guide: A black sphere where the caster looks. It pulls everything in and pins it down, then collapses.
spell.pohsmp_core.space_closure.guide: A Coven seal. For twenty seconds a seal forms over the caster and everyone around watches. Then space closes into a dome: nobody can enter, leave or move through it, not even the caster. Inside, only the caster can work magic.
spell.pohsmp_core.wind_ascension.guide: The caster rises in a column of light striking foes with beams from the sky, then descends and heals allies.
ui.pohsmp_core.ashless_flame.rings: Three rings: %s damage each up to %s blocks, can be jumped
ui.pohsmp_core.eternal_blizzard.edge: The wall pulls back: leaving is possible, but slow
ui.pohsmp_core.eternal_blizzard.slow: Slowness II at the center up to V at the wall
ui.pohsmp_core.forbidding_seal.rune: Broken rune: %s damage, pulled back inside
ui.pohsmp_core.nightmare_cradle.dread: Not woken: Dread for %s s and knockback
ui.pohsmp_core.space_closure.cast: Cast: %s s, cannot be interrupted, a cutscene for everyone within 64 blocks
ui.pohsmp_core.space_closure.magic: Inside, only the caster can cast and drink potions
ui.pohsmp_core.space_closure.recast: Casting it again lifts the dome
ui.pohsmp_core.space_closure.spent: When the dome falls, the caster is spent for %s s with no mana
ui.pohsmp_core.space_closure.wall: Creatures, projectiles, teleports and damage cannot pass the wall
